ownership.geometry: unchanged authored STEP and offline OCP/NVIDIA meshes
ownership.pose_amplitudes: matched-commit app endpoint declarations, interpolated relative to CAD Rest
ownership.axes_signs: authored CAD local-X/Z convention bound to extracted source cylindrical pin axes
ownership.controller: CADCLAW research JavaScript adapter; no USDPhysics or servo commands

limitations: Source browser thumb lift/pronation is deliberately not transferred to the old vertical CAD hinge; optional sweep is palm-plane motion, not true opposition or grasp validation.
Spread is unavailable. Servo bodies and all tendon/elastic groups remain fixed. Five existing capstans receive source-app visual spin only; no mechanical drive/deformation relationship is validated.
Zero slider values are exact authored Rest.100percent uses source-app display endpoints, not hardware motion limits or a validated fist.
No collision, grasp, contact, actuator, tendon-length, hardware or physical validation. NVIDIA numerical qualification remains RED.
Later48c66 source fixed-oblique189degree controller and latercb16STEP are separate revisions.
